input.command:
cat > /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research/issue117/runs/run_f8049f2ce2774d7c/agents/geometry/candidate.json <<'EOF'
{
  "candidate_id": "geometry-asymmetric-next-item-hyperbolic-semantic-id",
  "behavior_problem_id": "predict-next-item-under-strongly-directed-interaction-transitions",
  "behavior_evidence_sha256": "793d52dce39a5a8aa3963ff566ae50612114b9d20d31227dfed3d1e9fc653b9b",
  "literature_evidence_sha256": "da8513020aac9ac437bf0be5f5aa888c493a9c6118cb3c76a8d34a4c2fa94a36",
  "next_item_hypothesis": "Among the train-only longest-prefix histories, 314605 of 339519 distinct directed item pairs (92.66%) had no observed reverse event. This supports testing prediction of asymmetric next-item transitions, but does not establish their cause or that negative curvature improves prediction. Hypothesis: for transitions whose items lie at different learned hierarchy levels, a hyperbolic semantic-ID representation will improve held-out next-item ranking versus capacity-matched Euclidean and graph controls, by representing broad branching and fine-grained distinctions with less distortion. Treat this as a falsifiable hypothesis, not a measured effect.",
  "math_definition": "Use curvature -1 Poincare ball B^32={x in R^32: ||x||<1}. For each item i, learn a Euclidean tangent vector v_i and map it to x_i=exp_0(v_i)=tanh(||v_i||)v_i/||v_i||, with exp_0(0)=0. Define the operator D(x,y)=2 artanh(||(-x)⊕y||), where Mobius addition a⊕b=((1+2<a,b>+||b||^2)a+(1-||a||^2)b)/(1+2<a,b>+||a||^2||b||^2). For a history h, encode its prefix with a fixed-capacity sequence encoder into query q_h in B^32; score candidate next item j by s(h,j)=-D(q_h,x_j)^2 plus a learned scalar item bias. Quantize the item tangent/ball representation with a fixed three-level residual semantic-ID quantizer (256 codes per level), and train autoregressive next-code prediction from the observed prefix. Clamp norms below 1-epsilon and use stable artanh evaluation.",
  "hyperbolic_necessity": "The measured evidence is directional asymmetry, not a tree or hierarchy measurement, so it cannot prove negative curvature is necessary. The proposed geometric rationale is conditional: if the asymmetric transitions reflect branching from broad item groups into more specific destinations, negative curvature can place exponentially many fine distinctions at increasing radius while keeping related branches near one another. Test only whether this conditional representation advantage translates into ranking gains; the observed 92.66% alone is insufficient evidence for it.",
  "euclidean_control": "Train the same sequence encoder, item embeddings, three-level 256-code quantizer, autoregressive objective, optimizer, data, and parameter/compute budget with 32-dimensional Euclidean embeddings and negative squared Euclidean distance. Include a fixed-capacity directed-graph control using only training-prefix transition edges, matched parameter budget and ranking head; neither control may use future/test edges. Report ranking metrics and parameter counts under identical splits and tuning budget.",
  "effect_site": "Item semantic-ID geometry and the candidate-item scoring distance; keep the history encoder and autoregressive code-generation pathway otherwise matched across geometric controls.",
  "real_trigger_measurement": "On validation histories formed only from allowed past events, measure next-item Recall@K/NDCG@K overall and stratified by training-prefix transition asymmetry (whether the source-destination pair has an observed reverse transition in training), item frequency, and history length. Primary comparison is the predeclared full-validation ranking metric against both matched controls; use no test/future events for trigger construction or model selection. The supplied aggregate reverse fraction is descriptive evidence only and is not itself a per-example trigger.",
  "training_only_inputs": "Use only the supplied frozen current-only train-prefix behavior evidence and training interactions for fitting item vectors, hierarchy/quantizer, transition graph control, model parameters, and any strata thresholds. Do not use prior-candidate prompts, validation/test interactions to construct representations, or unseen future/test interactions.",
  "stable_global_sid": true,
  "protocol": {
    "latent_dim": 32,
    "levels": 3,
    "codes_per_level": 256,
    "hyperparameter_sweep": false,
    "uses_future_events": false
  },
  "falsifier": "The hypothesis is falsified if, under the fixed protocol and identical evaluation, the hyperbolic model does not improve the predeclared validation next-item ranking metric over both the matched Euclidean and graph controls, or if any apparent gain disappears on the prespecified asymmetric-transition stratum. A gain only from extra capacity, leakage, or post-hoc tuning does not count. No result should be claimed from the supplied aggregate evidence itself."
}
EOF
